svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_host_checker Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_host_checker:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class is defined to check exceptions injected into the packets and also checks BTA response packets transmitted from the receiver side. It also checks word count for the long packets.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_host_checker::dsi_read_request_sent

Indication for DSI Read request send by DSI transmitter device. This will be reset, when BTA is executed and receiver xactor transmits the response and status packet. This variable is implemented to verify that each read request is followed by BTA.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_host_checker::eotp_packet_received

This field is set, when a end of transmission packet is received in HS transmission. This field is used to check, if the transmission ends with end of transmission based on it's configuration.

 bit [15:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_monitor_host_checker::vertical_scrolling_area

It describes height of the Vertical Scrolling Area in the number of lines of Frame Memory. Its first line start immediately after the top most line of the top_fixed_area and ends immediately before bottom most line of bottom_fixed_area.
